The 2026 midterm elections have so many high-stakes races and candidates, but
very few media organizations you can trust to cover them all; these are the
moments **Zeteo** was built for**.**

[ Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Join our election livestream **TONIGHT,** starting at **9pm ET** (**6pm PST /
2am GMT)** to watch **Mehdi** and **Prem** usher in the results from Detroit,
Michigan, and speak to people on the ground at one of the most-watched Senate
races of the year, Abdul El-Sayed vs. Mike Rogers. But stay alert! We might go
live as early as **8pm ET (5pm PST / 1am GMT)** if results from other races
start pouring in.

Speaking of other races, **Zeteo's** **Swin Suebsaeng** will support our live
election coverage in Ohio to see Vivek Ramasawmy's gubernatorial campaign
through to the end, and **Andrew Perez  **in Maine will report whether this is
_finally_ game over for Sen. Susan Collins. Safe to say, **Zeteo** has both
you and the news covered this upcoming election night.

Every media organization in the U.S. will compete for your attention tonight;
be sure to give it to an outlet that will deliver the results as they are -
unfiltered and without a hidden agenda.
